entries.title: SOC 2 and GDPR Compliance Support
body: The Risk360 service supports the following compliance frameworks for risk assessment:
- System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2)
- See image.
- General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
- See image.
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

entries.title: ZAgent for Risk360
body: ZAgent is powered by agentic AI to enhance the capabilities of the AI virtual assistant that is dedicated to troubleshooting multistep tasks and answering complex questions. The Risk Analysis AI agent is designed to enhance your organization’s ability to identify and scope risk within your Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) environment by using Risk360.
See image.
To learn more, see About ZAgent and Understanding ZAgent with Use Cases.

entries.title: Risk Factors for Web Applications
body: The following 3rd-party connector-based factors under the External Attack Surface category are available to quantify risk from web applications:
- Is WAF Enabled
- Is WAF Enforced
- Is DDoS Protection Enabled
Reach out to your Zscaler Account team to implement these factors.
To learn more, see Integrating 3rd-Party Connectors for Risk Factors and Viewing Risk Factors.

entries.title: Risk Factors for Application Lifecycle
body: The following factors under the Compromise category are available to quantify risk for an application's lifecycle:
- Application End-of-Life
- Application End-of-Support
To learn more, see Viewing Risk Factors.

entries.title: Risk Factors for DNS Security
body: The following factors under the Compromise category are available to quantify risk for your DNS-based traffic:
- Blocking Critical DNS Domain Category
- Blocking High Risk DNS Domain Category
- Blocking Risky DNS Domain Category
- Blocking Critical DNS Tunnels
- Blocking High Risk DNS Tunnels
- Blocking Risky DNS Tunnels
- Blocking Unknown DNS Traffic
To learn more, see Viewing Risk Factors.

entries.title: Risk Factors for Privileged Remote Access
body: The following factors under the Compromise category are available to quantify risk for Privileged Remote Access (PRA):
- File Upload Inspection for Privileged Console
- File Upload Inspection for Privileged Portal
- Restricting File Download & Clipboard Copy
To learn more, see Viewing Risk Factors.

entries.title: HECVAT Risk Framework Support
body: The Risk360 service supports HECVAT compliance for risk assessment.
See image.
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

entries.title: Risk Factors for SaaS Security Posture Management
body: The following factors under the Data Loss category are available to quantify risk for your SaaS Security Posture Management traffic:
- Risky Third-Party App Usage
- Risky Posture in Essential SaaS Applications
- Risky Posture in Advanced SaaS Applications
To learn more, see Viewing Risk Factors.

entries.title: HITRUST Risk Framework Support
body: The Risk360 service supports HITRUST compliance for risk assessment.
See image.
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

entries.title: CAF Risk Framework Support
body: The Risk360 service supports Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) for compliance and risk assessment.
See image.
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

entries.title: CIS Risk Framework Support
body: The Risk360 service supports the Center for Internet Security (CIS) framework.
See image.
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

entries.title: HIPAA & PCI DSS Risk Framework Support
body: The Risk360 service supports the following frameworks:
- Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
- Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

entries.title: Enhanced Risk Frameworks
body: The following updates are available pertaining to risk frameworks:
- Search for a technique by its name or the factor mapped to it on the compliance framework pages.
- Download the framework as a CSV file.
- Add, edit, or delete notes for techniques in frameworks and in the Details drawer on the Factors page.
See image.
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

entries.title: DORA & NIS2 Risk Framework Support
body: The Risk360 service supports the following frameworks:
- Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA)
- See image.
- Network and Information Security Directive 2 (NIS2)
- See image.
To learn more, see Assessing Compliance.

entries.title: Operating Entity Risk Report
body: A weekly and on-demand Operating Entity Risk Report is added to the Reports page to conduct portfolio risk assessment by quantifying risk at the operating entity level. You can also change the entity source for the report.
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Risk Reports and Managing Operating Entity Risk Report Settings.

entries.title: Data Loss Prevention Factors
body: The following factors under the Data Loss category are available in the Risk360 Admin Portal that quantifies risk for your Data Loss Prevention (DLP) traffic:
- Data in Motion
- Overly Permissive DLP Policies
- Incorrectly Configured DLP Policies
- Block Mode Policy with Organizational Unit Exceptions
- Usage of Custom Engine in Policy
- DLP Policies for Critical File Types
- Data at Rest
- Data at Rest Scanning Policies
- Usage of Custom Engine in Policies
- Saas Security Scan Configuration
- Endpoint DLP
- Incorrectly Configured Endpoint DLP Policies
- Usage of Custom Engine in Policies
- Outbound Email DLP
- Overly Permissive DLP Policies
- Incorrectly Configured Email DLP Policies
- Block Mode Policies with Organizational Unit Exceptions
- Usage of Custom Engine in Policies
- General DLP
- Usage of Index Tool Virtual Machines for EDM and IDM
- Usage of EDM and IDM
With the preceding factor additions, the existing Are DLP Policies Configured factor is no longer available.
To learn more, see About Factors.

entries.title: Cyber Insurance Addendum Report
body: You can download the Cyber Insurance Addendum Report, a comprehensive quarterly and on-demand report of your zero trust security posture.
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Risk Reports.

entries.title: Factor for Posture Profiles Not Used in Access Policies
body: The factor Posture Profiles Not Used in Access Policies under the Lateral Propagation category is available to quantify risk for access policies without a device posture profile.
See image.
To learn more, see About Factors.

entries.title: Support for ISO 27001 Framework
body: The Risk360 service supports the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an information security management system (ISMS) for your organization.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk with ISO 27001.

entries.title: Support for Custom Peer Score Settings
body: You can add custom strategies for peer score calculations and switch between them to view peer scores calculated based on different attributes such as industry vertical, geographical region, and revenue range.
See image.
When a new peer score strategy is enabled, the Risk Score Trend graph indicates it with the Event indicator and the score changes for that date.
See image.
To learn more, see Managing Peer Score Settings and About Dashboard.

entries.title: Support for NIST SP 800-53
body: The Risk360 service supports the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publication (SP) 800-53 that provides guidance on selecting, implementing, and assessing security and privacy controls for federal information systems and organizations. This publication helps organizations comply with the Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) and other regulations.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk with NIST SP 800-53.

entries.title: Support for Gen AI Risk Factors
body: The Risk360 service supports three generative AI factors under the Data Loss category to quantify your organization's risk for user data privacy, sensitive data loss, and usage risk when interacting with generative AI apps.
See image.
To learn more, see About Factors.

entries.title: Risk Management Mitigation Strategy Report
body: You can download the Risk Management Mitigation Strategy Report that outlines the mitigation strategy for important risk factors impacting your organization's cyber risk. This report is autogenerated once a week.
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Risk Reports.

entries.title: Support for Deception Risk Factors
body: The following 5 Deception factors are added to the Risk360 Admin Portal for your organization's risk quantification:
| Factor Name | Risk Category |
| Internal Decoys Deployed | Lateral Propagation |
| Zero Trust Network Decoys Deployed | Lateral Propagation |
| Active Directory Decoys Deployed | Compromise |
| Threat Intelligence Decoys Deployed | External Attack Surface |
| Endpoint Deception Deployed | Data Loss |
To learn more, see About Factors.

entries.title: Ability to Customize Breach Probability
body: You can edit the Zscaler-computed breach probability to the values of your choice using the Simulate toggle on the Monte Carlo Simulation page (Financial Risk > Monte Carlo Simulation). The organization's financial exposure is reevaluated based on new values. You can restore the Zscaler-computed probability at a later time if required.
See image.
To learn more, see Quantifying Loss With Monte Carlo Simulation.

entries.title: Enhanced Financial Risk Architecture
body: The following enhancements are available for the financial risk architecture in the Risk360 Admin Portal:
- You can manage various settings for your organization's financial risk calculation from the Financial Risk Settings section on the Account page.
- See image.

- The existing financial risk exposure calculation method has been updated. Therefore, the Loss Curve chart on the Financial Risk page might show a spike or drop in the graph from the date the calculation method is updated.
- See image.
To learn more, see Managing Financial Risk Settings and About Financial Risk.

entries.title: New Factors Added for Compromise
body: The Compromise category is updated with 15 factors under the following new factor groups:
- Identity Protection: Active Directory
- Identity Protection: Entra ID
- Identity Protection: Credential Exposure
To learn more, see About Factors.

entries.title: Enhanced Alerts
body: The Alerts feature is enhanced with the following updates in the Risk360 Admin Portal:
- The table in the Ongoing Alerts tab shows the alert ID and mute status of the alert rule.
- See image.
- The table in the Alerts History tab shows the alert ID of the alert rule.
- The Ongoing Alert drawer shows the alert trigger cause history and the change at various levels (i.e., organization, category, factor group, and factor).
- See image.
- 5 predefined customizable rule templates are added to the Add Alert Rule wizard.
- See image.
To learn more, see About Alerts and Configuring an Alert Rule.

entries.title: Enhancments to Asset Details
body: The Events Contributing to Risk Score for Last 7 Days section on the Asset Details page is enhanced with the following updates:
- For each risky event, you can view the:
- Threat Category
- Threat Name
- URL Category
- URL Name
- Export all events contributing to the risk score change to a CSV file.
- View all events contributing to the risk score change in a drawer by clicking View All Events.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing an Asset Risk.

entries.title: Ability to Include or Exclude Items For Risk Computation
body: You can include or exclude individual items (i.e., servers and vulnerabilities) from risk score computation from the Investigate page. The changes are captured in the audit logs with the username and reason provided for the action.
See image.
To learn more, see Investigating Sections of a Problem.

entries.title: Support to Scan Multiple Domains for External Surface Attack
body: You can add multiple domains in the Risk360 Admin Portal to scan and identify publicly exposed assets for quantifying risk and mitigating potential cyberattacks. The risk assessed is visualized in the form of risk factors which can be further drilled down to the investigate page.
See image.
To learn more, see About Seeds Management, Adding Domains Using a CSV, and Adding a Domain for External Attack Surface Analysis.

entries.title: Investigate with Decoy Domains
body: You can filter and view data for Zscaler decoy domains within your network when investigating problem cards under the External Surface Attack category.
See image.

entries.title: Renamed Sub-factor under Advanced Threat Settings
body: The existing sub-factor, Kerberos Authentication Bypass for Certain URLs, under the Advanced Threat Settings factor is renamed to Custom Denylist Configuration for URLs.
See image.
To learn more, see About Factors.

entries.title: New Factor for External Attack Surface
body: A new factor, SSL/TLS Certificate Expiration, is added to the External Attack Surface category that quantifies risk based on your organization's expired and soon-to-be expired SSL/TLS certificates.
See image.

entries.title: Support for NIST CSF 2.0
body: The Risk360 service supports NIST CSF 2.0 in the Risk360 Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk with NIST CSF.

entries.title: Alerting Support in Risk360
body: You can configure and receive alert notifications based on criteria defined in the alert rules as emails or webhooks.
See image.
To learn more, see About Alerts, Understanding Alert Email, and ServiceNow Webhook Configuration Guide.

entries.title: New Factors Added Under UEBA
body: The following new factors are added under the UEBA factor group, for the Data Loss category:
- Code Repository Made Public
- Code Repository Shared Externally
- Bulk Files Delete Operation
- Data Uploads to High-Risk Countries
See image.

entries.title: Tenable Factors Support in Risk360
body: The Risk360 service supports integration with the Tenable Vulnerability Management solution to quantify the risk associated with the vulnerabilities in your organization. The Zscaler service calls the Tenable Vulnerability Management API to request various risk-related information, categorizes the risk under Risk360's External Attack Surface category, and quantifies risk by taking into account the common vulnerability scoring system (CVSS) score, vulnerability priority rating (VPR) score, exploit code maturity, and threat recency.
See image.
To learn more, see Tenable Integration For Risk360 Factors.

entries.title: Support for Asset-Level Risk Scoring
body: You can view the risk score assigned to all your organization's assets and other important metrics in the Risk360 Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see About Asset-Level Risk and Analyzing an Asset Risk.

entries.title: Export Factors
body: You can export the factors contributing to your organization's risk score into a CSV file from the Factors page using the Export icon.
See image.
To learn more, see About Factors.

entries.title: Enhanced Posture Profile Card
body: The Posture Profile card (Insights > Posture Profile) in the Risk360 Admin Portal is enhanced with the following new widgets:
- Access Policies without Posture Profile: This graph shows the trend for the number of access policies for the last 90 days.
- See image.
- 5 Access Policies without Posture Profile: This section shows the access policies without a posture profile for the last 7 days.
- See image.
Click the Investigate link under these preceding widgets to view the data in a table for all access policies without a posture profile. You can filter the data using the filter options.
See image.

entries.title: Enhanced Segmentatation Card
body: The Segmentation card (Insights > Segmentation) in the Risk360 Admin Portal is enhanced with the following new widgets:
- Application Segments with Open Ports: This graph shows the trend for open ports for the last 90 days.
- See image.
- 5 Sample Application Segments with Open Ports: This table shows random application segments with open ports. The table consists of the following columns:
- Name
- Defined TCP Port Ranges
- Defined UDP Port Ranges
- See image.
Click the Investigate link under these preceding widgets to view the data in a table for all application segments with open ports.
See image.

entries.title: Enhanced SSL Inspection Card
body: The SSL Inspection card (Insights > SSL Inspection) in the Risk360 Admin Portal is enhanced with the following new widget:
Top 5 Uninspected User Traffic by URL Hosts: This bar chart shows the top 5 uninspected URL hosts and their corresponding traffic volume for the last 30 days.
See image.
Click the Investigate link under the preceding widget to view the data in a table for the top 100 uninspected URL hosts. You can filter the data using the filter option.
See image.

entries.title: Risk360 Integration with ZSLogin
body: Risk360 supports the ZIdentity service that allows you to single sign-on (SSO) to the different Zscaler admin portals using a single set of login credentials.

If you are subscribed to the ZIdentity service, admins are listed as read-only on the Administrators page and the Administrator Management page shows an SSO link to the ZSLogin Admin Portal where you can manage your admins.
To learn more, see What Is ZSLogin?, About Administrators, and Understanding Administrator Management Settings.

entries.title: Viewing Top 10 Key Events Affecting Risk
body: You can view the top 10 key events that contributed to your risk score (in the last 90 days) by clicking Key Events in the Risk Score Trend graph on the Dashboard page.
See image.
To learn more, see About Dashboard.

entries.title: CrowdStrike Factors Support in Risk360
body: The Risk360 service supports integration with CrowdStrike to show you risk contributing factors. The Zscaler service calls the CrowdStrike Falcon API to request various risk related information, categorizes them under Risk360 categories (External Attack Surface, Compromise, Lateral Propagation, and Data Loss), and quantifies each factor according to its risk weight.
See image.
To enable this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.
To learn more, see About Factors and CrowdStrike Integration For Risk360 Factors.

entries.title: Access Various Risk Reports & Docuements
body: You can access the following risk-related reports and documents from the Reports page in the Risk360 Admin Portal:
- CISO Board Slides
- Attack Surface Report
- Cybersecurity Maturity Assessment
- SEC Disclosures
- Miscellaneous
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Risk Reports.

entries.title: Log Support for Score Change
body: You can view event logs that contribute to score changes across Risk360 categories and factors from the Score Change Logs tab on the Audit Logs page (Administration > Audit Logs > Score Change Logs).
See image.
To learn more, see About Audit Logs.

entries.title: Risk360 Support For MITRE ATT&CK
body: You can analyze your organization's risk with the MITRE ATT&CK framework, a cybersecurity framework funded by the government that is used to detect, identify, and classify various tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) used for cyber attacks by attackers. The new MITRE ATT&CK page (Frameworks > MITRE ATT&CK) helps you with assessing your organization's security posture and calculating the risk of a cyber attack.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk With MITRE ATT&CK.

entries.title: Risk360 Support For NIST Framework
body: The Risk360 service supports the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) cybersecurity framework (CSF), a set of recommendations and processes that you can implement and follow to strengthen your organization's security posture against malicious attackers that also guides how to respond and recover from an event of security breach. Considered a very high-standard risk management tool across the industry as it provides great value at any stage of your cybersecurity journey.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Risk With NIST CSF.

entries.title: Support for Monte Carlo Simulation
body: The Risk360 Admin Portal supports the Monte Carlo Simulation (Financial Risk > Monte Carlo Simulation) to show you the probability of loss for various risk scores (i.e., inherent risk, residual risk, etc.).
See image.
To learn more, see Quantifying Loss With Monte Carlo Simulation.

entries.title: Access Zscaler Admin Portals From Risk360
body: You can access various Zscaler admin portals from the Risk360 drop-down in the left-side navigation and the Factors page to manage your configuration and policies as per Risk360's recommendations to reduce attack risk.
See image.
To learn more, see Accessing and Navigating the Risk360 Admin Portal and About Factors.

entries.title: Support for Risk360 Audit Logs
body: The Risk360 service records the login name and IP address of every user who logs in to the Risk360 Admin Portal and adds or modifies configurations.
See image
To learn more, see About Audit Logs.

entries.title: Support for SAML Authenticaton for Risk360 Admins
body: The Risk360 service supports identity provider (IdP)-initiated SAML authentication for admins. You can configure SAML for Risk360 admins with Okta.
To learn more, see SAML Configuration Guide for Okta.

entries.title: Introducing Risk360
body: Risk360 is a 360-degree risk management platform that holistically measures, quantifies, and helps remediate risky activities from various entities, configurations, and external attack surface data from your overall Zscaler environment to provide the most comprehensive and actionable risk framework the industry has to offer.
Enabling Risk360 for your organization allows you to:
- Analyze your organization's security data to get real-time risk metrics and quantification.
- Gain in-depth visibility into your risky assets and configurations.
- Glance at your organization's risk from financial, industry standards, and peer perspectives.
- Mitigate risk exposure by performing actionable recommendations through intuitive workflows.
To learn more, see What Is Risk360?
